name: RadioDoge
author: DogeGo
description: Connect a RadioDoge Heltec V3 SoftAP device to broadcast signed transactions over LoRa when offline, and relay inbound mesh txs to the local node when online. Same HTTP API as Dogecoin Wallet RadioDoge support.

rpc.name: should_use_radio
rpc.help: Whether offline + RadioDoge should carry broadcasts.

rpc.name: broadcast
rpc.help: POST signed tx hex to SoftAP /api/broadcast (mesh).

rpc.name: broadcast_smart
rpc.help: Local sendrawtransaction or RadioDoge mesh depending on connectivity.

rpc.name: send_direct
rpc.help: POST signed tx to /api/transaction for one LoRa address.

rpc.name: configure_gateway
rpc.help: Push saved gateway credentials to the device.
